prompt: Create one accurate sparse Chinese heritage INK LINE DRAWING of the ACTUAL ancient Xiaotangshan Guo family funerary STONE SHRINE (孝堂山郭氏墓石祠), based on image 1: a very small human-height two-bay Eastern Han stone chamber inside a later protective hall. Image 2 is only the project's delicate black line style sample. This is NOT the much larger red-and-white modern protection building, NOT the entrance gate, and NOT a commemorative stele. Show the complete freestanding ancient stone chamber from a front-left three-quarter view: solid thick bluestone slab walls, low single-eave pitched gable roof carved to imitate roof tiles, short overhanging eaves, central entrance between front supports, broad simple low plinth. Preserve the compact squat proportions of the real photo. Suggest weathered shallow relief or inscriptions only by sparse abstract nonlegible strokes, never invent Chinese characters. Remove the enclosing hall beams, information panels, railings, people and floor. Fine charcoal black contour lines, sparse stone seams, no black masses. Center in landscape 4:3 with ample margin; the entire background and visible open entrance gap must be flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, no shadow, gradient, paper texture, glow, checkerboard or transparency.
